note: Per-paper upstream lineage for the corpus expansion. 'artifact' is the last commit touching the stage's persisted output; 'code' the last commit touching the stage's implementation (including semantic dependencies). verdict rerun/reuse per the staleness rules; no Scout or figure-extraction LLM rerun is required anywhere: those artifacts are current with the prompts/models that generated them.

parse.basis: reuse: parse code unchanged since the artifact was generated

inventory.basis: reuse: inventory code change (e947e24, caption-by-printed-figure) predates the committed artifacts

scout.basis: reuse (validated): scout.json was generated by the CURRENT scout prompt/model (gemini-flash-latest) and co-committed with that code (e038973/7e23dc6); no prompt change since

figures.basis: reuse (validated): figure_extract change eb45570 is an explicitly backward-compatible per-series-axis extension ('every record written before this field existed behaves exactly as before'); its one data correction (d0ra09876k Fig.3a) was applied in that same commit

geometry.basis: rerun (deterministic, no LLM): 663e05c changed the deterministic classifier semantically (named-structure keywords no longer require numeric corroboration; experiment-local geometry precedence) after every geometry.json was written

pressure.basis: reuse: pressure code unchanged since the artifacts were generated

resolve.basis: rerun (deterministic, --resolve-only, no LLM): resolver and its canonical-layer dependencies (process_steps, conditions) changed after every resolved/ artifact (c5fa50c 08-13, 663e05c 08-18)

canonical.basis: rerun (deterministic, no LLM): canonical layer dependencies (axis_semantics, comparison_targets, rules) changed after every canonical/curves.json; also downstream of the resolve rerun
